story: Khayelitsha police are investigating a murder after a 25-year-old man was shot dead by gunmen in Trekker Road, near an Engen garage, at about 17:00 on Tuesday 13 October (Daily Voice, quoting police spokesperson Ndakhe Gwala).
location_note: Trekker Road near an Engen garage, Khayelitsha. Trekker Road could not be found on the map, so the pin is a general Khayelitsha point, not the scene.
